title: Low-Code Developer
summary: Low-code developers build business apps such as claims, onboarding or approval systems on visual low-code platforms (tools where you drag and configure most of the app), adding code only where needed. They sit in IT or consulting delivery teams and work closely with business analysts and product owners.
dailyDuties: Build screens, workflows and data models on the platform
Write SQL and integrate other systems through APIs
Turn user stories into working features each sprint

skills.expectation: Build business apps on at least one low-code platform
